critical_code_review_comments: stripHandoffFenceForDisplay() fix is minimal, correct, and localised — hadFence check uses same SHIP_FENCE_MARKER regex used elsewhere, ensuring consistency; only triggers when a fence WAS actually present AND stripped result is empty; whitespace handled via .trim(); fallback string is short and honest.
The 'double-checked by a second reviewer' badge (line ~1342) intentionally continues to check raw m.content — correct behaviour is preserved.

MessageBubble.jsx is now ~1450+ lines — worth considering a future split (e.g. extracting the streaming/thinking block, agent-chip, and scope-badge into sub-components) to keep it maintainable. Not blocking this fix.

rca_of_the_issue: Founder screenshot showed an assistant bubble with ONLY badges and no message body. Root cause: MessageBubble.jsx stripHandoffFenceForDisplay() removes the internal ```aurem-handoff fence for display (it drives the Ship button, not visible prose). When the LLM's entire reply was JUST the fence with zero surrounding prose, stripping left an empty string. RenderedMessage rendered empty; badges (which check raw unstripped m.content) still showed → blank body + orphan badge. Fix: when hadFence && stripped is empty, return a short fallback line. Verified: unit test t_no_prose_fence_shows_fallback_not_blank asserts non-empty output; t_fence_with_prose_never_falls_back asserts the prose-carrying case is unchanged. Both pass.
